'''Kal Vorusk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] working with [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] agent [[Govin Thane]] to stop a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. He was a hulking man who attempted to murder the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Spensor Kluub]] in Room 564 of the [[Grand Bespin Hotel/Legends|Grand Bespin Hotel]] in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].<ref name="Cloud Cover" />
